name: 0.91 inch OLED (SSD1306)
summary: Narrow 128 x 32 strip. Fits where the 0.96 will not.
source: Dimensions follow the commonly sold module. These are made by many suppliers to no common standard, so measure yours before cutting a panel. This one usually has no mounting holes at all, so it gets glued behind a cutout or held by its header. The glass stands about 2 mm proud of the board.
